name: Hot Air Balloon
description: The team pictures its project as a balloon: hot air lifts it, sandbags weigh it down, storm clouds are risks and clear skies are opportunities. A fun view of a project.

columns.name: Hot air
columns.prompt: What lifts us up and makes us go faster?

columns.name: Sandbags
columns.prompt: What weighs us down or slows us?

columns.name: Storm clouds
columns.prompt: What risks or threats do you see ahead?

goal.reflect-project: Covers helpers, blockers, risks and opportunities.

checkInQuestion: If you could travel anywhere in a balloon today, where would it be?
facilitationTips: Draw a big balloon with a basket and clouds to set the scene.
Ask people to write one idea per note.
Pick the most important sandbag and storm cloud to turn into actions.
